title: Hypercover row descent for an injective internal condensed module
statement: Let Lambda be a condensed commutative ring and I an injective internal Lambda_X-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let U be a simplicial object over a pro-etale X-object W whose augmentation and matching maps are epimorphisms after represented-sheaf formation. Then restriction from I(W), placed in cochain degree zero, to the extended alternating abelian section row [def-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-hypercover-augmentation] is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Constructible sheaves, Lemma 5.3(1)

proof.text: Use the proved sectionwise/internal module equivalence to reconstruct the coefficient ring sheaf and transport the injective. Its forward functor leaves the underlying abelian sheaf and restriction maps unchanged. Lift the site morphism universe with ULiftHom and transport along the resulting site equivalence, again preserving injectivity.

The represented matching-map epimorphisms give local compatible-boundary lifts. Apply ringed injective hypercover augmentation exactness to obtain injectivity in degree zero and exactness of all alternating section maps. Identify these functions with the underlying abelian section maps, prove the natural single-degree augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism, and extend by zero using the canonical single-complex extension isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem condensedHypercoverInjectiveRow
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (W : X.ProEt) (U : SimplicialObject (Over W))
    (hzero : Epi ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).yoneda.map (U _⦋0⦌).hom))
    (hone : ∃ c : Fan (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ U _⦋0⦌), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧
      ∃ μ : U _⦋1⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
        (∀ i : Fin 2, μ ≫ c.proj i = U.δ i) ∧
        Epi ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).yoneda.map μ.left))
    (hhigher : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∃ c : Cone (SimplicialObject.matchingBoundaryIndex U n).multicospan,
        Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ ∃ μ : U _⦋n + 2⦌ ⟶ c.pt,
          (∀ i : Fin (n + 3), μ ≫ c.π.app (WalkingMulticospan.left i) = U.δ i) ∧
          Epi ((Scheme.ProEt.topology X).yoneda.map μ.left))
    (I : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj Λ X)) [Injective I] :
    QuasiIso (Scheme.ProEt.abelianHypercoverRowAugmentationComplex X W U
      ((Mod.forget (condensedRingObj Λ X)).obj I))
